_comment: Content format rotation system. Each format has distinct constraints that prevent structural uniformity — the fingerprint that signals AI-generated content at scale.

formats.name: Deep Data Explainer
formats.description: Long-form synthesis of complex topics. High impressions, lower CTR — SERP often answers the query.
formats.bestFor: Topical authority, informational queries, entity association

formats.name: News Analysis
formats.description: Event-driven analysis tied to a specific trigger (IPO, earnings, funding round). Time-sensitive.
formats.bestFor: Breaking query capture, freshness signals, news waves

formats.name: Ranked List
formats.description: 'Best X for Y' or 'Top 10 Z' with a real methodology. Highest CTR format. Sponsors want placement here.
formats.bestFor: Comparison/buying intent queries, sponsor inventory, high CTR

formats.name: Question-Led
formats.description: Opens with a real GSC query. First sentence answers it; rest of post earns the click. Featured snippet magnet.
formats.bestFor: Featured snippets, direct-answer queries, high CTR

formats.name: Contrarian Take
formats.description: Pushes back against consensus. Requires a genuine position. High social sharing, inconsistent search.
formats.bestFor: Social distribution, brand voice, 'is X overvalued' queries

rules.formatWeightsExplained: Weights control selection probability. Higher weight = more frequent. Adjust based on your GSC CTR data.
